[comment by BlayTheNinth (member)]
I'm not seeing any errors related to Balm in that log. The error in line 408 is related to the update checker of some other mod and would not have any effect on the game.

[comment by CodenameMeleon (none)]
> I'm not seeing any errors related to Balm in that log. The error in line 408 is related to the update checker of some other mod and would not have any effect on the game.

IlYeah, it doesnt say Balm specifically, but it populates when I have Balm enabled and is not there with it disabled specifically with this build so far. When I have a fresh install with just Balm it is not there which is why I'm thinking it's some sort of overlapping arguments.

[comment by BlayTheNinth (member)]
Balm does not use ModMenu's update checker. Any relation is most likely purely coincidental.

For reference, here is an issue report [of the same on the ModMenu repository](https://github.com/TerraformersMC/ModMenu/issues/878), and [the associated fix that went into ModMenu](https://github.com/TerraformersMC/ModMenu/pull/842) on Minecraft 1.21.5+.

[comment by CodenameMeleon (none)]
Ahh. Thank you!
